## 27a915a2c9b3 — prototype + ready

The canonical halo rule is preserved byte-for-byte. The new nondefault setting first executes that rule, then selects the unique largest four-connected blue halo component in the resulting grid and recolors it to 8. Its counterfactual skips the halo stage and therefore has no eligible blue component.

A bounded review found and repaired a teaching shortcut: early edge clipping made the row-major-last component largest in both initial examples. The teaching prefix now alternates the largest component while retaining clipped cases later. The existing generator test was also made portable by resolving canonical data through `reviewer_support`; no base generator behavior changed.

## c6fa0b0b24da — repaired + ready

The base generator was rewritten around its existing exact canonical bounding-box-fill rule. It now has deterministic local RNG, strict scalar/unknown-axis rejection, observable controls, disjoint palettes, a Python rule mirror, and task-local tests.

The new nondefault setting fills the canonical bounding box, computes the connected regions of cells newly created by that fill, and recolors the unique largest new region to 8. Its wrong-order program recolors before the fill, which erases the distinction and changes the final output.

previous_catalog_record.summary: 0-bg grid (h~7-9, w~8-10) with 2-5 NON-BG CELLS all the SAME COLOR (from {1..9}), scattered at distinct positions. Two extreme cells are placed to force a bbox spanning ≥3 ROWS AND ≥3 COLS (diagonal endpoints); additional cells are scattered anywhere (may extend the bbox). Rule (REPLACE WITH SOLID RECTANGLE OF THE BBOX, FILLED IN THE INPUT COLOR): compute BBOX (min row, min col, max row, max col) of all non-0 cells. IDENTIFY the INPUT COLOR (only non-0 color in input). PRODUCE a NEW h × w OUTPUT (or input-shape) where: every cell strictly INSIDE the BBOX (including border) is painted INPUT COLOR; every cell OUTSIDE the BBOX is 0. Net: scattered same-color cells get replaced by their solid bbox rectangle in their color.

scope: Accepted generator repair; finite reviewer evidence, no new maintainer execution

sequential_dependency.intermediate: The solid bounding-box grid plus the four-connected regions of cells newly created relative to the original input.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Apply the exact canonical rule to fill the foreground bounding box with the input color.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Select the unique largest newly created region in the intermediate and recolor exactly that region to 8.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: Only Stage A defines which cells are newly created; selecting or recoloring before the fill either has the wrong eligibility mask or is overwritten by the fill.

parametric_work.summary: Canonical bounding-box fill plus an input-dependent largest-new-region recolor, identified from two demonstrations and backed by exact source inventory, authoring preflight, and protected wrong-order replay.
